system.description:
You create a condensed bubble of super dense air around you in an attempt to deflect incoming attacks. This barrier of wind has 2d8+5 hit points, and has resistance to Lightning damage and vulnerability to Fire damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the wind barrier hit points by 1d8
